_doc: Driver registry for the products module. 'registered' entries exist in the lab's qtyFor() at RC8.11 and are verified against the live lab file by tools/check.mjs (drift => failure). 'proposed' entries do not exist in the lab (P2: quantities produced by the spool engine that have no qtyFor() key yet; owner decision required before any index.html change). Entries flagged qtyForOnly are keys in qtyFor() that no ACTS row uses as its driver; entries flagged awaitingGeometry return 0 until geometry() supplies the g field. Entries flagged modelDerived (P2.1) are registered quantities produced by the spool engine as E0 evidence records beside qtyFor(): not lab qtyFor() keys, no ACTS consumer; tools/check.mjs asserts exactly that state and tools/check-quantities.mjs proves each appears once.

EQUIP_EA.costAttachment: A07 M = qty*g.equipUnitCost*costF (flat 62000/EA, index.html:2094-2095); EQT meshes are proxy boxes only

PTS_EA.costAttachment: A12 M = qty*matU*costF; EA counts DDC points

DAMPER_FSD_EA.costAttachment: none yet: A04's ACTS driver is DUCT_LBS; a cost allowance in estimate() is a later phase
DAMPER_FSD_EA.note: Registered in qtyFor() (index.html:2113). geometry() does not yet supply damperFsdEA, so the quantity is 0 until a later phase provides it.

EXH_FAN_EA.costAttachment: none yet: A07 cost is equipEA x equipUnitCost and excludes exhaust fans; an estimate() allowance is a later phase
EXH_FAN_EA.note: Registered in qtyFor() (index.html:2114). geometry() does not yet supply exhFanEA, so the quantity is 0 until a later phase provides it.

DUCT_LF.note: No ACTS activity consumes this driver and it is not a lab qtyFor() key, so it never reaches estimate(); the quantity is an E0 evidence record derived from the spool engine (index.html untouched).
